title: Singles Strategy Center Line (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 136bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
One on one, full court to cover
Singles pickleball, no partner, discover

[Verse 1]
Singles court is full width, twenty feet wide
You cover every line from side to side
Serve to the backhand corner, start there first
Backhand return is shorter, less burst

Stay behind the baseline after the serve
Come in behind your third shot, hold your nerve
Net position wins in singles play
Get to the kitchen line, there you stay

[Pre-Chorus]
Backhand corner serve, then come in
Third shot drop to the kitchen, begin
Net position is the singles win
Backhand serve, third drop, settle in

[Chorus]
Singles strategy, serve the backhand wide
Third shot drop, advance inside
Cover the center line from the net
Singles strategy, the winning set

[Verse 2]
Center line theory in singles play
Most returns come back up the center way
Position one step left of center after the serve
Cut off the center return, hold the curve

Cross court rally to the backhand deep
Then redirect down the line, the point to keep
Set up with cross court, finish down the line
Singles strategy, that is the design

[Bridge]
Bluey: Brilliant singles strategy here, she is controlling the center line brilliantly
Trevor: In singles play, center line dominance accounts for sixty-seven percent of point wins
Michelle: Serve backhand. Third shot drop. Own the center. Redirect down the line.

[Chorus]
Singles strategy, serve the backhand wide
Third shot drop, advance inside
Cover the center line from the net
Singles strategy, the winning set

[Outro]
Backhand serve
Third drop
Center line
Singles strategy
